import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Define New Mexico polygon (approximate bounds)
new_mexico = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[
    [-109.05, 37.00],  # NW
    [-103.00, 37.00],  # NE  
    [-103.00, 31.33],  # SE
    [-109.05, 31.33],  # SW
    [-109.05, 37.00]   # Close
]])

# Time range: 2000-2016 (MODIS starts in 2000, covers 17 years of the requested 30)
years = list(range(2000, 2017))  # 2000 to 2016 inclusive

# 2. Data Acquisition & Processing
lst_data = {}

for year in years:
    # Define July period (June 21 to Aug 10 to capture all July days in 8-day composites)
    start_date = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 6, 21)
    end_date = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 8, 11)
    
    # MODIS LST 8-day product
    collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A2') \
        .filterBounds(new_mexico) \
        .filterDate(start_date, end_date) \
        .select('LST_Day_1km')
    
    # Check if collection has data
    count = collection.size().getInfo()
    
    if count == 0:
        print(f"{year}: No images")
        lst_data[year] = None
        continue
    
    # Calculate mean LST for July period
    # Apply scale factor (0.02) and convert from Kelvin to Celsius
    mean_img = collection.mean().multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15)
    
    # Get pixel count to check for valid data
    pixel_count = mean_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=new_mexico,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
    
    if pixel_count == 0:
        print(f"{year}: No valid pixels")
        lst_data[year] = None
        continue
    
    # Get mean LST value
    mean_lst = mean_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=new_mexico,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
    
    # Validate the result
    if mean_lst is None or not isinstance(mean_lst, (int, float)):
        print(f"{year}: Invalid result")
        lst_data[year] = None
    elif mean_lst < -50 or mean_lst > 60:  # Unreasonable LST range for New Mexico in July
        print(f"{year}: Unreasonable value: {mean_lst:.1f}°C")
        lst_data[year] = None
    else:
        lst_data[year] = mean_lst
        print(f"{year}: {mean_lst:.1f}°C, Pixels: {pixel_count}")

# 3. Analysis & Final Answer
# Check if we have data for 2016
if 2016 not in lst_data or lst_data[2016] is None:
    print("No valid data for 2016")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
else:
    # Get valid years with data
    valid_years = {year: lst for year, lst in lst_data.items() if lst is not None}
    
    if len(valid_years) < 2:
        print(f"Only {len(valid_years)} year(s) with valid data")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # Find maximum LST and corresponding year
        max_year = max(valid_years, key=valid_years.get)
        max_lst = valid_years[max_year]
        lst_2016 = valid_years[2016]
        
        print(f"2016 LST: {lst_2016:.1f}°C")
        print(f"Max LST: {max_lst:.1f}°C in {max_year}")
        print(f"Years with data: {len(valid_years)}")
        
        # Check if 2016 is the highest
        if max_year == 2016:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
